CONVENTION CONFIRMED FROM HISTORY, NOT ASSUMED. Whether days-since-last-deal counts whole elapsed timestamps or calendar days decides whether these five move at all at 00:30 GMT: by elapsed timestamp AIG (534672883905, created 1 Nov 19:33 GMT) is still 10 days and nothing moves; by calendar date it is 11. The figure increments at midnight GMT, so this is the calendar convention and the same rollover applies now. Patched rather than asked because runbook section 2 lists days since last deal as refreshed automatically and a date rollover is the ordinary way it changes.
